evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-13"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-13". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The value is a plain YYYY-MM-DD date with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-11-01"} returned 200 and set the date. PATCH /todos/3 with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and dueDate became null. A later GET /todos/4 still showed the changed date.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "14.10.2026", "2026-10-14T10:00:00Z" and the number 20261014 each returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" and "bad" each returned 400. The stored date stayed unchanged after the rejected PATCHes.
evidence.AC4: Today in UTC is 2026-10-14. Todos created: past (due 10-13), future (10-15), today (10-14), none (no date), and a done todo due 2020-01-01. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the past todo. The done todo with a 2020 date had overdue false once I PATCHed done:true. The todo due today, the one without a date and the future one were not overdue. GET /todos?overdue=false returned all the others.
evidence.AC5: The list page in Playwright showed "past · fällig: 13.10.2026 · überfällig", "future · fällig: 15.10.2026", "none · fällig: 01.11.2026" and "pastdone ✓ · fällig: 01.01.2020". Each todo with a due date displayed it. The todo with no date (id 3, shown as "today") showed none.
evidence.AC6: On the list page only the overdue todo "past" carried "überfällig". The future, no-date, done-with-old-date and today-titled todos did not.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". I clicked it, and the list went from 5 items to only "past · fällig: 13.10.2026 · überfällig".
